TPP-04.18 — AUDITORIA DAS DEFINIÇÕES DE HORÁRIO PT RIO

Objetivo:
- localizar onde PT_RIO_SCHEDULE_NORMAL é definido;
- localizar onde PT_RIO_SCHEDULE_WED_SAT é definido;
- verificar a regra de substituição 18h → 19h;
- identificar todos os consumidores antes da alteração.

  146: const RJ_EXPECTED_HOURS_BASE_DESC = ["21:00", "18:00", "16:00", "14:00", "11:00"];
  147: const FEDERAL_EXPECTED_HOURS_DESC = ["20:00", "19:00"];
  148: 
  149: function isFederalInput(scope) {
  150:   const up = safeStr(scope).toUpperCase();
  151:   if (!up) return false;
  152:   if (up === SCOPE_FEDERAL) return true;
  153:   if (FEDERAL_INPUT_ALIASES.has(up)) return true;
  154:   const compact = up.replace(/[\s_]+/g, " ").trim();
  155:   if (FEDERAL_INPUT_ALIASES.has(compact)) return true;
  156:   const unders = up.replace(/[\s_]+/g, "_");
  157:   if (FEDERAL_INPUT_ALIASES.has(unders)) return true;
  158:   return false;
  159: }
  160: 
  161: function normalizeScopeInput(input) {
  162:   const s = safeStr(input).toUpperCase();
  163:   if (!s) return SCOPE_RJ;
  164:   if (s === SCOPE_RJ) return SCOPE_RJ;
  165:   if (isFederalInput(s)) return SCOPE_FEDERAL;
  166:   return s;
  167: }
  168: 
  169: function scopeDisplayName(scope) {
  170:   const up = safeStr(scope).toUpperCase();
  171:   if (up === SCOPE_RJ) return "RIO";
  172:   if (isFederalInput(up)) return "FEDERAL";
  173:   return up;
  174: }

    9: function getDatesBetween(start, end) {
   10:   const dates = [];
   11:   let d = new Date(start);
   12:   const endDate = new Date(end);
   13: 
   14:   while (d <= endDate) {
   15:     const y = d.getFullYear();
   16:     const m = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0");
   17:     const day = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, "0");
   18:     dates.push(`${y}-${m}-${day}`);
   19:     d.setDate(d.getDate() + 1);
   20:   }
   21: 
   22:   return dates;
   23: }

  210:   const up = safeStr(scope).toUpperCase();

  212:   if (up === SCOPE_FEDERAL) return true;
  213:   if (FEDERAL_INPUT_ALIASES.has(up)) return true;
  214:   const compact = up.replace(/[\s_]+/g, " ").trim();
  215:   if (FEDERAL_INPUT_ALIASES.has(compact)) return true;
  216:   const unders = up.replace(/[\s_]+/g, "_");
  217:   if (FEDERAL_INPUT_ALIASES.has(unders)) return true;
  218:   return false;
  219: }

  524: 
  525:       const sch2 = getScheduleForLottery({
  526:         lotteryKey: key,
  527:         ymd: curY,
  528:         PT_RIO_SCHEDULE_NORMAL,
  529:         PT_RIO_SCHEDULE_WED_SAT,
  530:         FEDERAL_SCHEDULE,
  531:       });
  532: 
  533:       const arr2 = Array.isArray(sch2) ? sch2.map(toHourBucket) : [];
  534:       if (!arr2.length) break;
  535:       curH = arr2[0];
  536:     }
  537: 
  538:     steps += 1;
  539:   }
  540: 
  541:   return { slot: null, draw: null };
  542: }

 4182:     const drawsToday = range.filter((d) => pickDrawYMD(d) === ymd);
 4183: 
 4184:     const dayTimeline = buildTimelineForDate({
 4185:       ymd,
 4186:       drawsToday,
 4187:       drawsRange: range,
 4188:       lotteryKey,
 4189:       PT_RIO_SCHEDULE_NORMAL,
 4190:       PT_RIO_SCHEDULE_WED_SAT,
 4191:       FEDERAL_SCHEDULE,
 4192:     });
 4193: 
 4194:     allTimeline.push(...(Array.isArray(dayTimeline) ? dayTimeline : []));
 4195:   }
 4196: 
 4197:   return auditTop3Timeline({
 4198:     timeline: allTimeline,
 4199:     lotteryKey,
 4200:   });
 4201: }

 4159:     });
 4160: 
 4161:     allTimeline.push(...(Array.isArray(dayTimeline) ? dayTimeline : []));
 4162:   }
 4163: 
 4164:   return auditTop3Timeline({
 4165:     timeline: allTimeline,
 4166:     lotteryKey,

   94: export function getFederalPreferredHourForYmd(ymd) {

   99:   return "19:00";

  109: function isFederalInput(scopeInput) {
  110:   const up = String(scopeInput || "").trim().toUpperCase();
  111:   if (!up) return false;
  112:   if (up === FEDERAL_SCOPE_CODE) return true;
  113:   if (FEDERAL_INPUT_ALIASES.has(up)) return true;
  114:

  116:   const compact = up.replace(/[\s_]+/g, " ").trim();

  118:     FEDERAL_INPUT_ALIASES.has(compact) ||
  119:     FEDERAL_INPUT_ALIASES.has(up.replace(/[\s_]+/g, "_"))
  120:   );
